fieldGuide.mult: Stat multipliers at 0 mastery (str, skp, stm = max stamina, def = defense, vit, pwr, ene, speed).
fieldGuide.masteredMult: The same multipliers at max mastery (only those above 1x change).
fieldGuide.drain: energy/stamina/health = per-second drain factor (see formRules for the formula); meleeStaminaCostMultiplier multiplies stamina per melee hit; stackDrainMultiplier applies to both forms' drains while base + stack are combined.
fieldGuide.masteryThresholds: Mastery needed for instant transform / jumping straight into the form / stacking / (unlockNeedsOnRequisite) unlocking from the requisite form.
fieldGuide.source: On a form inside a DMZ group: whether that form is DMZ's or added by Noea.
fieldGuide.dmzPreviousDefault: Would show DMZ's bundled default when a live form value differs from it; no DMZ-origin form differs in this config, so it never appears.

notes: Form numbers of DMZ-origin forms in the live config are identical to DMZ's bundled defaults; Noea only adds groups/forms (and patches skill prices, masters and visuals).

Class stats of the 7 DMZ races are DMZ 2.2.1's code defaults (ConfigManager.createDefaultStatsConfig), identical for every DMZ race. The bundled previousConfigs (2.2.0) had per-race values; those are legacy.

Alien and Sphinxian share one Noea class-stat table (SphinxianRaceConfigInstaller.stats) and Demon has a similar one; in all three, 7 of 8 class passives are disabled (only Unversed is on), and their regen values are flatter than the DMZ races'.
Racial skill numbers come from general-server.json racialSkills (Demon: noeabosses-v090.toml; Sphinxian: hard-coded).

stats.name: Strength
stats.effect: Basic melee (punch/kick) damage. Melee damage = 1 + (STR + bonus) x STR_scaling x STR multiplier x PowerRelease%. STR also adds 25% of its scaled value to Strike damage and counts toward Battle Power.

stats.name: Strike Power
stats.effect: Damage of Strike techniques (special physical skills). Strike damage = 1 + [SKP x SKP_scaling x SKP mult + 0.25 x (STR x STR_scaling x STR mult)] x PowerRelease%.

stats.name: Resistance
stats.effect: The defensive stat. Drives Defense (RES x DEF_scaling, plus a curved flat mitigation from DEF_scaling up to DEF_scaling_max), Max Stamina (RES x STM_scaling), part of stamina regen (sp5ResScaling) and, with the speed system on, movement/dodge Speed (1 + RES / 10,000 x form speed x PowerRelease%). Forms affect it through their 'def' and 'stm' multipliers; for Battle Power RES uses the average (def + stm) / 2.

stats.name: Vitality
stats.effect: Max Health through a curve: each point is worth VIT_scaling HP at first and ramps up to VIT_scaling_max HP per point at the knee (16,000 VIT). Also drives HP regen (hp5VitScaling) and stamina regen (the class field sp5StmScaling is applied to effective VIT in code). Counts half toward Battle Power.

stats.name: Ki Power
stats.effect: Ki attack damage. Ki damage = (PWR + bonus) x PWR_scaling x PWR multiplier x PowerRelease% (+ any Ki-damage attribute from gear).

stats.name: Energy
stats.effect: Max Ki pool: Max Ki = 20 + ENE x ENE_scaling x ENE multiplier. Also drives Ki regen (ep5EneScaling). Counts half toward Battle Power. A bigger Ki pool also makes the percentage part of form Ki drain larger.

statScalingKeys.DEF_scaling: Defense per RES point (also sets the Defense softcap/hardcap, see derived).
statScalingKeys.DEF_scaling_max: Flat-mitigation value per RES point reached at the defense knee (20,000 RES); flat mitigation ramps quadratically from DEF_scaling to this.
statScalingKeys.VIT_scaling: HP per VIT point at low VIT.
statScalingKeys.VIT_scaling_max: HP per VIT point at and above the knee (16,000 VIT).

derived.name: Max HP
derived.formula: 20 (vanilla base) + curve(VIT) x VIT multiplier. curve(v) = VIT_scaling*v + (VIT_scaling_max - VIT_scaling)*v^3 / (3*K^2) for v <= K, then + VIT_scaling_max*(v - K) above it; K = vitCurveKnee = 16,000.
derived.notes: Example (Saiyan Warrior, 1.8 -> 7.2): 16,000 VIT = 1.8*16,000 + 5.4*16,000/3 = 57,600 bonus HP. Flat VIT bonuses use the per-point rate at your current VIT. Applied as a Minecraft max-health modifier.

derived.name: Max Ki (Energy)
derived.formula: 20 (+ Max Energy attribute bonuses) + (ENE + bonus) x ENE_scaling x ENE multiplier

derived.name: Max Stamina
derived.formula: 20 (+ Max Stamina attribute bonuses) + (RES + bonus) x STM_scaling x STM multiplier
derived.notes: Forms change it through their 'stm' multiplier.

derived.name: Melee damage
derived.formula: 1 + (STR + bonus) x STR_scaling x STR multiplier x PowerRelease/100
derived.notes: Stamina cost per melee hit = ceil(melee damage without form multipliers x 0.083) x form staminaDrainMultiplier (x stack form's) x gravity-load drain factor.

derived.name: Strike damage
derived.formula: 1 + [SKP x SKP_scaling x SKP mult + 0.25 x STR x STR_scaling x STR mult] x PowerRelease/100
derived.notes: Martial Artist passive adds up to +25% against low-HP targets.

derived.name: Ki damage
derived.formula: Ki-damage attribute + (PWR + bonus) x PWR_scaling x PWR multiplier x PowerRelease/100
derived.notes: Then technique-specific modifiers (Human Android x0.85, Ki Surge, class passives).

derived.name: Defense and damage reduction
derived.formula: baseDefense = (RES x DEF_scaling + armor x 0.5 + toughness x 0.7) x PowerRelease/100 x max(1, DEF multiplier). %Reduction = d/(k+d) with k = softcap = max(12, 1,000,000 x DEF_scaling x 0.015): 50% at the softcap, then easing up to the 88% cap at the hardcap (1,000,000 x DEF_scaling x 0.05).
derived.notes: Order when hit: (1) flat mitigation = curved DEF (DEF_scaling -> DEF_scaling_max over 20,000 RES) x release x DEF mult, capped at 82% of the hit (a hit is cancelled outright if flat mitigation >= 2.5x its size); (2) % reduction above; (3) Protection enchantments (total cap 93%); (4) adaptive mitigation up to 65% extra when the hit is small relative to your flat defense. Guard break cuts defense by 66%. Forms can raise DEF but never lower it below 1x for mitigation.

derived.name: Critical hits
derived.formula: Base crit chance 5% (attribute crit_chance), crit damage 1.5x (attribute crit_damage)
derived.notes: Berserker passive adds +10% / +25% crit chance at low HP. Gear and effects can raise the attributes.

derived.name: Max Poise
derived.notes: Defense here is the release-scaled stat defense including armor (see Defense).

derived.name: Battle Power (BP)
derived.formula: BP = 1200 x (raw/100)^1.2 x PowerRelease/100, raw = STR*s*m + SKP*s*m + RES*DEF_scaling*m(RES) + PWR*s*m + 0.5*(VIT*s*m + ENE*s*m)
derived.notes: s = class scaling, m = total multiplier (forms, effects). RES uses the form's (def+stm)/2. Android-upgraded humans show max BP.

derived.name: Speed (speed system)
derived.formula: speed = 1 + (RES + bonus)/10,000 x form speed mult x stack speed mult x (2 if transformed) x PowerRelease/100; movement multiplier = 1 + (min(3, speed) - 1) x 0.85
derived.notes: Speed also feeds the speed-dodge system (combat.json). Base-form players get no x2.

derived.name: Health regen
derived.formula: HP/sec = (baseHp5 + effectiveVIT x hp5VitScaling)/5 x enchant x max(0, 1 - flat form health drain/10) x Glind 1.25 x other effects
derived.notes: effectiveVIT includes form VIT multipliers. Tank passive adds bonus HP regen from stamina regen; Berserker boosts it at low HP.

derived.name: Ki regen
derived.formula: Ki/sec = (baseEp5 + effectiveENE x ep5EneScaling)/5 x (1 + 0.05 x Meditation lvl) x enchants; charging: x1.5 x (1 + 0.25 x Ki Boost lvl), min 1/sec
derived.notes: Android-upgraded humans x2. Regen only while below max (when not charging).

derived.name: Stamina regen
derived.formula: SP/sec = (baseSp5 + effectiveVIT x sp5StmScaling + effectiveRES x sp5ResScaling)/5 x (1 + 0.05 x Meditation lvl) x enchants x max(0, 1 - flat form stamina drain/50)

derived.name: Power Release
derived.formula: Max release % = floor((50 + 5 x Potential Unlock level) x racial multiplier)
derived.notes: Saiyan Zenkai can raise the racial multiplier by up to +15%. All damage, defense, BP and form drains scale with current release. Hit mastery only accrues at 50%+ release.

derived.name: Level
derived.formula: level = 1 + floor((totalStats - startingStats) / (6 x maxValue - startingStats) x (maxValue - 1)), maxValue = 1,000,000
derived.notes: So level is roughly your average stat. With maxLevelValueInsteadOfStats = true, individual stats have no 1,000,000 cap; only the 6,000,000 total does.

derived.name: TP cost per stat point
derived.formula: cost = max(16, (16 + 1.25 x T) x globalTPCost x class tpCostMultiplier - max(0, 140 - T)), T = current total stats; above T = 300,000 (5% of the total cap) the 1.25 x T part grows as T^0.7 instead
derived.notes: The first ~140 points get an early-game discount. Cleric (0.9) is the only class with cheaper points in the live config.

derived.name: TP gain
derived.formula: TP gained = base x (1 + sum of (each boost - 1)) - boosts add, they do not multiply
derived.notes: Boosts include class tpGainMultiplier, Frost Demon racial (+25%), Hyperbolic Time Chamber (1.75), dead in Otherworld (2.0), Mutant (1.25), gravity training, weights, potions and (story TP only) difficulty. Except for training TP, a progression bonus is also added: +0.75 x sqrt(current point cost / point cost at level 10,000), capped at +0.75, so TP gain rises as stats get more expensive.

races.name: Human
races.summary: Earth's versatile fighters. No raw power edge, but cheaper Ki attacks, faster technique learning and an adrenaline safety net; humans alone can be turned into Androids by Dr. Gero.

racialSkill.name: Human Adaptation (Fast Learner, Blood-Fueled Ki, Adrenaline; Android Core and Absorption Barrier once upgraded)
racialSkill.effect: Fast Learner: techniques gain +35% XP. Blood-Fueled Ki: Ki attacks cost 25% less Ki; part of the saving (12.5% of the original cost) is paid in HP and added to the attack's next hit, never dropping you below 2 HP. Adrenaline: falling to 25% HP or less gives 15s of -30% damage taken, +25% attack speed and +25% move speed (cooldown 180s, re-arms after HP rises above the threshold). After Dr. Gero's Android upgrade: Android Core - Ki attacks cost 50% less with no HP cost, Ki regen x2, but Ki attacks deal 15% less damage; Absorption Barrier (hold G, up to 10s) - Ki blasts that hit it deal no damage and refill 50% of their damage as Ki; overflowing past 50% over max Ki forces a Ki Surge, past 75% the barrier breaks and the excess hits you. Barrier cooldown 30s (180s if broken). Android-upgraded humans can only use Android forms (Super/Legendary forms are blacklisted) and show max Battle Power.

godforms.note: No levels: this race cannot buy this skill.

passive.summary: Fury: every 3 melee hits in a row that are not blocked (within 3s of each other) grant a stack, up to 5. Each stack gives +10% stamina regen; at 5 stacks you also get 10% armor/defense penetration. Stacks expire 5s after your last hit.
Damaging Ki attacks recharge 20% faster; damaging Ki attacks that also apply a debuff recharge 15% faster and their debuff lasts 25% longer.
Strike techniques deal up to +25% damage based on the target's missing health: no bonus above 75% target HP, full bonus at or below 25%, linear in between.
Below 66% HP: +25% HP regen and +10% crit chance. Below 33% HP: +75% HP regen and +25% crit chance instead.

Party aura (party members within 50 blocks, same dimension): 15% of the damage a party member takes is redirected to you (reduced by your own defense, never below 1 HP), and you heal for 15% of the damage your party members deal. Needs a party of 2+.
50% of your stamina regen is added as bonus HP regen, and healing you receive (not food) is 25% stronger. Below 30% HP both bonuses are multiplied by 2.
Healing Ki attacks recharge 20% faster; healing Ki attacks that also grant a buff recharge 15% faster and the buff lasts 25% longer.

Resonance: firing a Ki attack empowers your next 3 melee hits (or your next Strike, used within 3s) by +15%; landing 3 melee hits (within 5s) or a Strike empowers your next Ki attack by +15%. Charges last 8s.

Celestial Body: HP, Ki and stamina regen x1.25; Meditation dodge chance vs melee x1.5. passive.summary: Fury: every 3 melee hits in a row that are not blocked (within 3s of each other) grant a stack, up to 5. Each stack gives +10% stamina regen; at 5 stacks you also get 10% armor/defense penetration. Stacks expire 5s after your last hit.
Damaging Ki attacks recharge 20% faster; damaging Ki attacks that also apply a debuff recharge 15% faster and their debuff lasts 25% longer.
Strike techniques deal up to +25% damage based on the target's missing health: no bonus above 75% target HP, full bonus at or below 25%, linear in between.
Below 66% HP: +25% HP regen and +10% crit chance. Below 33% HP: +75% HP regen and +25% crit chance instead.

Party aura (party members within 50 blocks, same dimension): 15% of the damage a party member takes is redirected to you (reduced by your own defense, never below 1 HP), and you heal for 15% of the damage your party members deal. Needs a party of 2+.
50% of your stamina regen is added as bonus HP regen, and healing you receive (not food) is 25% stronger. Below 30% HP both bonuses are multiplied by 2.
Healing Ki attacks recharge 20% faster; healing Ki attacks that also grant a buff recharge 15% faster and the buff lasts 25% longer.

Resonance: firing a Ki attack empowers your next 3 melee hits (or your next Strike, used within 3s) by +15%; landing 3 melee hits (within 5s) or a Strike empowers your next Ki attack by +15%. Charges last 8s.

formRules: Two slots: a 'base' form (race groups in races/<race>/forms) and a 'stack' form (shared groups in forms/, e.g. Kaioken, Ultimate, Ultra Instinct). A stack form can be added on top of a base form only if both are formStackable, neither lists the other in incompatibleWith, and both have at least their stackOnMastery mastery.

Multipliers stack ADDITIVELY by default (multiplicationInsteadOfAdditionForMultipliers = false): total = 1 + (form - 1) + (stack - 1) + (effects - 1) + (other buffs - 1), then x God-Ritual Ki-share. Example: SSJ2 STR 2.45 + Kaioken x2 1.1 = 2.55x, not 2.695x. If the server flag is true they multiply instead.
Each form has separate multipliers for STR, SKP, STM (max stamina), DEF (defense), VIT, PWR, ENE and speed. Anything that asks for 'RES' (e.g. Battle Power) uses (def + stm) / 2.

Mastery (0 to maxMastery, usually 100) raises every multiplier that is above 1x: effective = base x (1 + mastery/maxMastery x (maxStatsMultiplier - 1)). With the common maxStatsMultiplier of 1.5, a fully mastered 2.45x form gives 3.675x. Multipliers at or below 1x are not changed by mastery.
Mastery also lowers drains: drain x (1 + mastery/maxMastery x (maxCostMultiplier - 1)); with maxCostMultiplier 0.75 a mastered form costs 75% of its base drain.

Mastery is gained per hit dealt (masteryPerHitDealt) and per hit taken (masteryPerHitReceived) only while Power Release is 50% or higher; the per-hit value is scaled from 1x (hit <= 20% of the target's max HP) up to 4x (hit >= 80%), plus +0.25% per point of bonus gravity. Every ~5 seconds in the form you also gain passiveMasteryEveryFiveSeconds. Potions and the Frost Demon racial (+25%) multiply gains. shareMasteryWith copies the gain (x shareMasteryMultiplier) to the listed forms.

Mastery thresholds on each form: instantTransformOnMastery = mastery needed to transform instantly (otherwise you charge up); allowFreeTransformOnMastery = mastery needed to jump straight into this form from base or another group (the first form of a group never needs it); stackOnMastery = needed before a stack form can be combined with it; unlockOnMastery = mastery needed on the formRequisite form(s) before this form unlocks (if unlockOnMastery is 0 the requisite is not enforced). Charging speed per step = 10 + min(15, mastery x 0.2).

Unlocking: a race form needs its group's form skill (superforms / legendaryforms / godforms / androidforms, or the group's own type for Noea groups) at level >= unlockOnSkillLevel. Skill levels are bought with TP at the prices in the race's character.json formSkillsCosts (or from a master when buyFromMaster is true; -1 = not purchasable with TP). Buying the skill level is blocked until any levelRequisite (character level) and sagaRequisite (story quest) of the forms at that level are met. Stack forms use the skill named after their formType with prices from skills.json.

Forms in a group are climbed in order: transforming again while in a form moves to the next form of the selected group. Selecting a different group (or a later form) jumps there, subject to allowFreeTransformOnMastery.

Drains are paid once per second while transformed (baselineFormDrain = 80). Ki: flat part = max(1, sum over active forms of energyDrain x mastery cost factor x PowerRelease/100, x 80 x gravity-load factor) x max(1, your un-buffed damage total / (5 x max Ki)); plus a percentage part = max Ki x (sum of energyDrain)/100 x 0.75 x mastery cost factor. Example: SSJ2 (energyDrain 0.25) alone at 100% release and 0 mastery = 20 Ki/s flat (more if your damage outgrows your Ki pool) + 0.1875% of max Ki per second. Stamina and health drains (only when the form's staminaDrain / healthDrain is above 0) use the same flat formula (ratio against 1.5 x max stamina / max HP) plus 0.5% of max stamina / max HP per second. With a base and a stack form both active, each form's flat drain is multiplied by both forms' stackDrainMultiplier (usually 2 x 2 = 4x). Gravity-training load multiplies drains (x1.15 to x2.0). While a form drains health, HP regen is multiplied by max(0, 1 - flat health drain/10), and stamina regen by max(0, 1 - flat stamina drain/50); e.g. Kaioken x4 and above (healthDrain >= 0.125, i.e. >= 10 flat) stop HP regen entirely.

If you cannot pay a drain (not enough Ki, stamina or HP) you drop out of both forms immediately. Android-upgraded humans revert to Android Base instead of base, and Frost Demons who reached Final Form in Evolution never revert below Final Form.
staminaDrainMultiplier multiplies the stamina cost of every melee hit; attackSpeed multiplies attack speed; speedMultiplier multiplies the speed stat.

Instant transformation (allowed once the form's mastery reaches instantTransformOnMastery) costs 4x the form's adjusted Ki drain value up front (free in creative). Triggered forms (e.g. auto-triggered rage forms) do not gain mastery.

Masters: form skills with buyFromMaster = true must be learned from an NPC master first (e.g. God Forms from Whis/Beerus, Kaioken from King Kai). Noea also makes the Grand Priest offer almost every skill, lists Ultra Ego only at Beerus (purchase allowed only after the Destroyer questline), and adds Beast to Gohan.

Ultimate (stack): unless ultimateFormFixedValue is true, its multiplier is (your best unlocked, mastery-adjusted base form multiplier) + (Ultimate's own multiplier - 1). Forms listing 'ultimate.ultimate' in incompatibleWith (most legendary and top-tier forms) are skipped when picking the best form and cannot be combined with Ultimate.
God Ritual (Super Saiyan God ritual form): multiplier = 1 + (best normal form multiplier - 1) x (1 + 0.30), or +0.45 for a Mutant, never below the ritual form's own values.

Mutant/Legendary forms: the 'legendaryforms' group belongs to the Mutant system. While a Mutant's Rage is active or full they can use one legendary tier above their skill level ('rage-borrowed'); such a borrowed form is worth min(best normal form + 0.5 x share, the fully mastered legendary value). With Rage active a Mutant's legendary multipliers get +33% of their bonus.
Racial modifiers on top of forms: Frost Demon Power Reserve adds +15% of a form's bonus while it feeds the form; Saiyan/God-Ritual and Mutant bonuses are applied only to multipliers above 1x.

Missing fields in a form config (some Noea-added forms omit levelRequisite and sagaRequisite) fall back to DMZ code defaults (levelRequisite 0, no saga lock, maxMastery 100, maxStatsMultiplier 1.25, maxCostMultiplier 0.5, per-hit mastery 0.01). The 'mult' values in this file already have those defaults applied.
Otherworld: while dead, forms speed up the Otherworld revive timer by (otherworldTimeDrain - 1), interpolated toward otherworldTimeDrainMastered with mastery.

Noea gate: these form families need Buu Saga quest 35 ('Return to Earth') completed before they can be bought or used: God Forms, God Ki Enhancement, Ultra Instinct, Ultra Ego, Frost Demon God Forms, Frieza Bio Data, Piccolo Bio Data, Orange Piccolo, Divine Rose and Beast.
